title: A Long-term Follow-up Study of Participants Who Received Delandistrogene Moxeparvovec (SRP-9001) in a Previous Clinical Study (EXPEDITION)
official: A Phase 3, Multinational, Long-Term Follow-Up Study to Evaluate Safety and Efficacy in Subjects Who Have Previously Received SRP-9001 in a Clinical Study (EXPEDITION)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the long-term safety of delandistrogene moxeparvovec
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Received delandistrogene moxeparvovec for Duchenne muscular dystrophy in a previous clinical study
2. Has (a) parent(s) or legal caregiver(s) or is ≥18 years of age and able to understand and comply with the study visit schedule and all other protocol requirements
